name: volmanaged
headline: volmanaged: Moreira-Muir inverse-variance leverage (5 tunables), ALL GATES PASS on dev_1990 (Sharpe 0.4946, maxDD -19.80%, 1.78 chg/yr, plateau 100%) and clears every 1950-2012 era; avg leverage 0.63x with 0% days in cash -- a continuously de-levered market exposure, not a market-timing exit, so it trails buy-and-hold in calm/bull eras and captures only 11.4% of the +67.4% 2009 rebound.
biggest_weakness: No directional input, and the asymmetric no-trade band effectively fires at most one de-lever per crisis: once held leverage drops to/below band_dn=0.30 (e.g. 0.54x->0.20x in mid-Sep-2008), the band algebra (H_{t-1}-T_t>0.30 with T_t>=0) can never trigger a further decrease, so the identical 0.201x level was still in effect at the Oct-2008 Lehman capitulation, the Nov-2008 low and the Mar-2009 GFC low five months later -- and the same lack of directional input makes it trail SPY on Sharpe in every calm-to-bull era (1950-69: 0.51 vs 0.85; 1990-99: 0.81 vs 0.95; 1970-89: 0.10 vs 0.28), because avg_leverage_when_invested is only 0.63x.
